source: Bounded deterministic synthetic Arrow producer, 8192 rows per batch with 1024-byte binary payloads
storage: Disk-backed immutable object fixture with conditional publication and parent-owned loopback range reads
checks: each sealed part uploaded and local staging removed before continuing
DuckDB count and ID sum through signed HTTPFS
DuckDB SHA-256 comparison for every payload against deterministic reference hashes
scope: Component release gate; includes ingestion, immutable object publication, full verification and real DuckDB HTTPFS aggregation; not a cloud-provider or WAN throughput benchmark
limits: Peak RSS includes the synthetic source, storage fixture and in-process DuckDB; excludes filesystem cache and other processes
Not native database ingestion, a cgroup memory bound, micro-VM sizing or a concurrency measurement
Elapsed time covers several phases and does not isolate transfer or query throughput
Storage fixture shares the process and host; actual cloud latencies, quotas and credentials require separate acceptance
